experiments.title: The 7-Day Circadian Reset
experiments.tagline: Hard-resetting a broken sleep schedule with morning sunlight, walking, and strict light hygiene.
experiments.description: Seven days of morning sunlight immediately after waking, and a daily walking baseline. The goal: recalibrate the sleep clock without supplements or apps.
protocol: Wake up with the alarm. No snooze.
Immediately leave the house for a walk.

experiments.title: The 30-Day Public Speaking & Content Challenge
experiments.tagline: Thirty days of output: recording a 60 second video every day for release to Instagram. #higherupwellnesschallenge
experiments.description: Volume over polish. One 60-second video per day for 30 days. Stacking reps until the reps stop being scary.
protocol: Record one 60-second talk on a daily.
Schedule the video for posting to Instagram, no matter how cringe.
Review yesterday's output and pick one improvement.
Log reps, reach, and energy each evening.

experiments.title: The Social Media Growth Experiment
experiments.tagline: Growing an audience the honest way: raw numbers, real posts, no bought reach.
experiments.description: Documenting growth across platforms with zero paid promotion. Posting daily, tracking organic reach, and publishing the ugly metrics every week.
protocol: Publish a weekly metrics breakdown in public.
Engage 20 minutes per day in relevant communities.
Log followers, reach, and conversion weekly.

experiments.title: The Celibacy Experiment
experiments.tagline: 122 days celibate to finish 2026. No outsourcing my calm. I want to see what I'm actually using pleasure to avoid.
experiments.description: A 122-day experiment to finish 2026. No outsourcing my calm to finish the year. Tracking sleep, training, focus, and what I'm actually avoiding when urges hit
protocol: No first person or third person pleasure.
Train 3x per week with zero skipped sessions.
Monthly audit: what changed physically and mentally?
